title: Track a dispatched order
excerpt: Open Order History and choose Track shipment after dispatch. Standard delivery is normally 3–5 business days and express is 1–2 business days. The first scan may take 24 hours. Route to Shipping Review when tracking has not moved for three business days or the delivery window has expired.
keywords: tracking|shipment|carrier scan|dispatch|delivery status

title: Delivery is late
excerpt: Confirm dispatch date shipping service destination and the latest scan. If the parcel is beyond its delivery window or has no movement for three business days collect the order ID and tracking reference and route to Shipping Review. Do not promise an arrival date refund or replacement before investigation.
keywords: late delivery|delayed parcel|no tracking movement|shipping review|delivery window

title: Marked delivered but not received
excerpt: Ask the customer to check the address safe places reception household members and neighbours. If a courier says the box arrived but nobody can find it wait until 24 hours after the delivery scan then collect the order ID and confirm the address securely. Route to Shipping Review and do not promise an immediate refund.
keywords: delivered not received|courier says arrived|cannot find box|missing parcel|carrier investigation

title: Cancel an order
excerpt: Orders can be cancelled only before warehouse packing. Use Order History and choose Cancel order when available. If the control is absent collect the order ID and route to Order Support. Do not promise cancellation after packing or dispatch.
keywords: cancel order|before packing|stop shipment|order history|after dispatch

title: Change a delivery address
excerpt: An address can be changed only before warehouse packing through the approved secure workflow. If packing or dispatch has started explain that the label cannot be edited and route urgent cases to Order Support to check carrier options. Do not collect a full address in chat.
keywords: change delivery address|wrong address|before packing|redirect parcel|shipping label

title: Standard return policy
excerpt: Most unused products in original condition can be returned within 30 calendar days. Final-sale personalized perishable and opened hygiene products are normally excluded. Start the return from Order History and do not promise approval before checking eligibility.
keywords: return policy|30 days|return item|final sale|return eligibility

title: Exchange size or colour
excerpt: Eligible unused apparel and footwear can be exchanged during the 30-day return period while stock is available. Use Order History and choose Exchange. If the desired option is unavailable return the eligible item and place a new order. Final-sale and personalized goods are excluded.
keywords: exchange size|change colour|replacement stock|apparel exchange|wrong size

title: Refund processing time
excerpt: After an approved return Northstar Market refunds the original payment method. Banks normally display it within 5–10 business days. Ask for the order ID and confirmation date. If ten business days have passed route to Billing Review. Never request full card data.
keywords: refund pending|refund status|5-10 business days|original payment method|billing review

title: Damaged product
excerpt: Collect the order ID item packaging condition and safe photos. Ask the customer to keep the item and packaging. Smoke overheating leaking batteries sharp parts contamination or injury require urgent human review. Ordinary damage goes to Order Support for an eligibility decision.
keywords: damaged item|broken product|unsafe product|photos|replacement review

title: Wrong or missing item
excerpt: Collect the order ID expected and received items and packing-slip photos when available. Confirm whether a missing item is in a split shipment. Route evidence to Order Support and do not promise a refund or replacement before review.
keywords: wrong item|missing item|packing slip|split shipment|fulfilment error

title: Duplicate charge or authorization
excerpt: Distinguish one pending authorization from two completed charges. Collect the order ID dates amounts and approved payment identifiers through the secure workflow. Never request full card data. Completed duplicates chargebacks fraud claims or angry disputes require Billing Review.
keywords: duplicate charge|charged twice|pending authorization|billing dispute|double payment

title: Card declined at checkout
excerpt: Ask the customer to verify billing address expiry available funds and bank approval or use another supported payment method. Northstar cannot see the bank's private decline reason. Never request card security data. Repeated failures or suspected fraud require Billing Review.
keywords: card declined|payment failed|bank blocked|checkout payment|billing address

title: Download or correct an invoice
excerpt: After payment is captured open Order History select the order and choose Download invoice. Missing invoices need the order ID or purchase email through the secure workflow. Legal-name tax-ID or billing-address changes to an issued invoice require Billing Review.
keywords: download invoice|receipt|tax invoice|invoice correction|order history

title: Update a saved payment method
excerpt: Add or remove saved payment methods under Account Settings and Payments. Existing-order payment methods normally cannot change. Update a subscription default before renewal. Never collect full card data. Unrecognized payment changes require Security Ops.
keywords: update card|saved payment method|renewal card|billing settings|unknown card

title: Gift-card help
excerpt: Gift cards can be entered at checkout and do not expire. Ask for the purchase reference but never the complete code in ordinary chat. Lost stolen blocked or unexpectedly empty cards require Billing Review and proof of purchase.
keywords: gift card|voucher|empty balance|lost gift card|redeem code

title: Promotional codes
excerpt: Enter one valid code before payment. Codes normally cannot be combined or applied after purchase. Check expiry exclusions minimum spend geography and eligibility. If the terms were met but the code fails collect a screenshot and route for review.
keywords: promo code|coupon rejected|discount code|minimum spend|promotion eligibility

title: Cancel a product subscription
excerpt: Open Account Settings and Subscriptions and choose Cancel before renewal. Cancellation stops future renewals but does not refund a completed charge. A missing control continued renewal or completed disputed charge requires Billing Review.
keywords: cancel subscription|stop renewal|membership|recurring charge|billing cycle

title: Backorders and preorders
excerpt: Review the current estimate in Order History. Estimates can change and are not guarantees. A customer may cancel before packing when cancellation remains available. Route materially missed estimates missing updates or unavailable cancellation to Order Support.
keywords: backorder|preorder|release date|restock estimate|cancel preorder

title: International duties and taxes
excerpt: Local authorities may impose duties taxes or carrier fees that are separate unless checkout stated otherwise. Support cannot waive government charges. Route undisclosed amounts charged by Northstar to Billing Review and refer government assessments to local customs.
keywords: customs duty|import tax|international order|carrier fee|border charge

title: Marketplace seller orders
excerpt: Contact the seller through the secure order thread. Northstar can intervene after a missed response window invalid tracking or policy violation. Keep messages on-platform. Suspected counterfeit fraudulent prohibited or unsafe listings require urgent marketplace review.
keywords: marketplace seller|third party seller|invalid tracking|counterfeit|seller silent

title: Password reset
excerpt: Use Forgot password and the time-limited email link. Check spam and request a new link if it expired. Never share passwords or one-time codes. Lost email access requires Account Recovery; unexpected resets or account changes require Security Ops.
keywords: password reset|forgot password|expired reset link|cannot sign in|login help

title: Two-factor authentication
excerpt: Enable two-factor authentication in Account Settings and Security with an authenticator app and save recovery codes. Check automatic device time when codes fail. Never request a current code. Lost devices need Account Recovery and suspicious prompts need Security Ops.
keywords: 2fa|mfa|authenticator app|one time code|recovery code

title: Locked account recovery
excerpt: Wait for the lock period shown and use account recovery. If access remains blocked collect the account identifier through the secure workflow and route to Account Recovery. Do not bypass verification. Unknown activity or changed details make this a security incident.
keywords: locked account|too many attempts|account recovery|identity verification|cannot access

title: Suspected account takeover
excerpt: Unknown logins including a sign-in from overseas changed details unrecognized purchases or unrequested resets are critical. Advise a password reset from a trusted device if safe and securing the associated email. Immediately route to Security Ops. Never auto-resolve or request passwords or codes.
keywords: account hacked|signed in overseas|unknown login|unrecognized purchase|account takeover

title: Privacy access export and deletion
excerpt: Privacy requests must use the verified Privacy Request workflow. Legal retention may apply. Do not request government ID in ordinary chat or disclose data before verification. Verification problems legal deadlines or another person's data require Privacy Team review.
keywords: delete account|privacy request|data export|personal data|data access

title: Mobile app crashes or freezes
excerpt: Collect device OS app version screen and restart results. Recommend the latest supported app version and a stable network. Do not ask users to disable security. Persistent checkout or access failure goes to Tier-1 Technical; data loss payment retries or security warnings require human review.
keywords: app crash|mobile freezes|checkout closes|technical diagnostics|application failure

title: Order confirmation email is missing
excerpt: Check spam promotions purchase email and Order History. If no record appears collect approximate purchase time and amount through the secure workflow and route to Order Support. Do not expose another account's orders or recommend repurchasing before payment status is checked.
keywords: missing confirmation|order email|purchase not showing|order history|payment status

title: Product warranty claim
excerpt: When headphones or another product fail within the warranty period collect the order ID product model or serial fault description purchase age and safe photos or video. Route to Warranty Review without promising an outcome. Overheating smoke shock or injury requires urgent escalation.
keywords: warranty claim|headphones failed|product stopped working|four months after purchase|repair review

title: Loyalty points are missing
excerpt: Eligible points normally appear after payment and the return window. Cancelled refunded excluded or guest purchases may not earn points. Collect the order ID and loyalty identifier securely. If the window passed route to Billing Review and do not manually credit points.
keywords: missing points|loyalty balance|rewards|points not credited|guest purchase

title: Business and bulk orders
excerpt: For a formal quote covering hundreds of units such as two hundred monitors collect products quantities destination required date and business invoicing needs without payment credentials. Route requests above storefront limits to Business Sales. Negotiated pricing tax exemptions tenders and contracts require human review.
keywords: formal quote|two hundred monitors|bulk order|large quantity|business sales
